answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 830 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tundra. The nadir index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the wharf queue while honest participants promoted earlier still earns. Each impostor pays 2 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
